# Learn Python

> > Free, interactive Python tutorial platform for beginners to learn programming fundamentals through hands-on coding exercises in the browser.

Learn Python is a beginner-friendly educational platform created by Ron Reiter that offers free interactive Python tutorials and coding education. The site is part of the broader LearnX network of interactive learning platforms and emphasizes practical, browser-based coding practice for aspiring programmers.

## Getting Started

- [Learn Python - Free Interactive Python Tutorial](https://learnpython.org): Homepage for LearnPython.org's free interactive Python tutorial platform with hands-on coding exercises
- [Learn Python - Free Interactive Python Tutorial](https://www.learnpython.org): WWW variant of LearnPython.org homepage providing access to the free interactive Python tutorial

## About

- [Learn Python - Free Interactive Python Tutorial](https://learnpython.org/about): About page describing LearnPython.org's mission and interactive learning approach to Python education
